question: What effect on age-related death results from abstaining from food by day?
premises: Non-eating by day is the means described.
Age-related death is the object affected.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome age-related death.
uncertainties: divasāt nāśanena may mean fasting during the day or gradual reduction over days
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go beyond death from old age.
